question: What is the meaning of human toxicity non-cancerogenic in relation to essential environmental characteristics?
description: Human toxicity non-cancerogenic refers to the potential of a substance to cause adverse health effects in humans, excluding cancer. This is one of the predetermined environmental essential characteristics in the context of sustainable construction and life cycle assessment of a product. It is important to consider this characteristic when evaluating the environmental impact of a product.
